newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria says accepts management bid for AMAG.
newsitem.headline: Austria says accepts management bid for AMAG.

text.p: Austrian state holding company OeIAG said on Thursday it had accepted a management bid for aluminium maker AMAG, backed by Austrian industrialist Herbert Turnauer's Constantia group.

In a statement the OeIAG said the sale was in accordance with its privatisation guidelines. It guaranteed production and jobs at AMAG's plant in Ranshofen, Upper Austria, took account of Austrian interests and minimised the holding company's financial burden.
OeIAG gave no details of the winning bid from chief executive Klaus Hammerer and Turnauer.
Rival bids had been lodged by Herbert Liaunig of Austria's Auricon industrial group in conjunction with Bank Austria and German aluminium group VAW.
Austrian media have reported that AMAG will post an operating loss of around 150 million schillings this year.
Investment house SBC Warburg acted as advisor in the sale. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
